# Sentry — Sentry for Startups

Up to $5,000 in Sentry credits expiring after 12 months, plus priority support, for companies founded in the last 2 years that have raised under $5M in venture capital and have never paid for Sentry.

|---|---|
| **Status** | Open - apply directly |

## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | $5,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Credits expire after one year of joining the program. |



> **Stacking:** If you're a founder in YC or a16z speedrun, check bookface or the deals portal; there's a separate deal for you to consider, but they don't stack.

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

"New to paying for Sentry" means existing free-tier users are not excluded, only current/former paying customers. The headline program page https://sentry.io/for/startups/ renders its content client-side (an interactive terminal); its server HTML meta description and its vendor-hosted bundle both carry the $5,000 figure, and the apply page carries the full eligibility list in server HTML. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
